L105: 【37†Show Champion】 Chart winners (2023)
L106: ---
L107: 【38†Blackpink】's 【39†Jisoo】 (pictured) won her first ever music show and achieved her first triple crown as a soloist with her song "【40†Flower】". 【41†Nmixx】 (pictured) received their first ever music show win and had the highest score of the year with "【42†Love Me Like This】" on Show Champion March 29 episode.
L108: The Show Champion Chart is a 【43†record chart】 on the South Korean 【44†MBC M】 【45†television music program】 【37†Show Champion】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【46†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.^{【47†[1]】}
L109: In 2023, 31 singles reached number one on the chart, and 26 acts were awarded first-place trophies. "【42†Love Me Like This】" by 【41†Nmixx】 had the highest score of the year, with 9,176 points on the March 29 broadcast. "【40†Flower】" by 【39†Jisoo】 is the song to achieve a triple crown.
